selection.target: Explicit V4 library owner only; V2/V3 entry points and active/default HTTP wiring remain unchanged.
selection.novelty: Existing V4 native-store quarantine required an explicit caller latch. This slice binds detected custody/submission uncertainty to that interface and reads it into a fresh opt-in owner. Earlier explicit-store and witness/index results are retained, not replayed.

sourceBinding.actualImportClosure: Four authored modules, root package metadata and one selected entry; built-in-only imports. The native store and pure contracts are unchanged.

behavior.constructor: One synchronous quarantine read; never a constructor write. A valid persisted marker holds the fresh owner. An unavailable/invalid read holds PERSISTENCE_UNKNOWN without an automatic write.
behavior.automaticLatch: Detected custody or callback/submission uncertainty marks writeAttempted BEFORE one synchronous latch. The returned frozen DATA and readback must have equal detached fixed-order fields, configured scope/policy and valid digest grammar.
behavior.confirmation: PERSISTED_UNKNOWN means locally read-back quarantine metadata; not successful delivery, authenticated funding, native-store branding or send authority.
behavior.writeFailure: An unconfirmed/throwing latch or readback remains PERSISTENCE_UNKNOWN. No automatic retry, reset, clear or recovery action is provided.
behavior.nativeStorePremise: The captured synchronous native-store interface validates exact funding/header binding and the quarantine checksum. The owner does not independently authenticate that store or recompute its checksum.
behavior.recovery: A fresh V4 owner reads persisted generic uncertainty, not the historical local cause. Originals/intents remain readable as metadata; no original request or payment is resent.
behavior.lifecycle: close retains the identical cached Promise, reports UNKNOWN when held, and never closes the borrowed store.
behavior.limits: Record absence is not authority. Crash-before-detection, actual process restart, power loss, broad app/store qualification and default-client adoption are not established.

scenarios.name: V4 automatically commits callback uncertainty before reporting rejection
asserts: A rejected native callback Promise causes one native quarantine COMMIT before the owner rejection becomes observable.
The original submission cause remains true, custody/undrained flags remain false at that observation, and exactly one latch/readback confirms PERSISTED_UNKNOWN.
Original and intent bytes are retained; UNKNOWN close has cached Promise identity and leaves the borrowed native store usable.
A separate unquarantined grant completes only a declared callback. An unused V3 owner's snapshot has no V4 fields or counters.

scenarios.name: V4 automatically quarantines observed original loss without deleting native rows
asserts: After successful retention/fencing, a forwarding projection returns null for the known original while native rows remain intact.
The synchronous recovery error follows an automatic native quarantine COMMIT, and one-time persistence is not repeated.
Restoring the projection does not reset uncertainty. Fresh submission refuses before new store work/callback.
After all production handles close, independent read-only SQL sees three exact original/intent rows and two quarantine rows.

scenarios.name: fresh V4 owners restore persisted quarantine after a normal reopen
asserts: Normal reopen increments only the native owner epoch; originals, intents, quarantines, funding, policy and schema remain exact.
Fresh V4 owners for the two quarantined grants start held and block new submissions before new store work.
Recovery retains exact originals/intents with POSSIBLY_ATTEMPTED; it is not permission to send or delivery evidence.
The unquarantined grant remains metadata-readable and has no automatic quarantine write. This is not an actual process restart.

scenarios.name: post-commit quarantine failure stays UNKNOWN without a second automatic write
asserts: The existing afterCommit test hook throws only after the grant-D quarantine COMMIT in the second new private file.
The old owner reports PERSISTENCE_UNKNOWN with exactly one automatic write and zero confirmed readbacks; the original failure is not replaced by success.
Blocked submission, snapshots and close do not retry/reset. Independent SQL after closing all handles sees the committed marker and original/intent.
A fresh normal reopen reads PERSISTED_UNKNOWN and blocks; the old owner remains PERSISTENCE_UNKNOWN. All non-epoch rows stay exact.

scenarios.name: unavailable initial quarantine read holds a V4 owner without writing
asserts: A fresh V4 owner using the already-closed native store latches local custody uncertainty from one failed initial read.
It performs zero load/write calls; a new submission is blocked and UNKNOWN close retains cached Promise identity.
Repeated snapshots/close do not retry the getter or write. The closed native database's logical stamp stays exact.

callsite.timeoutBoundary: Not a hard native lifetime, cancellation, cleanup, OS or network sandbox guarantee.
callsite.nativeLoaderRunnerStreamOsSqliteAndFiles: Retained premises, not newly qualified global guarantees.

preservation.rawFixtureCleanup: HOLD, not CLEANED. No protected evidence or raw database deleted.
preservation.emptyFailedLoaderScratchCleanup: Only its owned zero-byte scratch was cleaned; protected failure streams and records remain.
preservation.quotaBoundary: Cooperative sampled accounting, not an OS-enforced aggregate quota.
preservation.runtimeDigests: Reused only after exact unchanged retained runtime identity tuples; no redundant large-binary rehash.

nativeFiles.scope: Exactly two new private synthetic files. No historical or user database is opened or modified.

authority.pr193: VALIDATED exact-same-signed-block resend remains distinct from UNKNOWN and ACKNOWLEDGED.

limits: These are source-bound selected local component outcomes, not a complete application, store, controller or SDK suite.
No actual process restart, crash, power loss, authenticated funding, real provider READY, real service delivery or live pilot is exercised.
The owner trusts the reviewed synchronous store interface; frozen grammar/readback equality is not an authenticated native-store brand.
No HTTP factory/default adoption or automatic request/payment resend is introduced. Other client versions do not acquire V4 volatile state automatically.
Independent current context, funding, payer/provider/policy authority, READY, durability, commit/uncertainty and restart/recovery remain separate acceptance gates.
